args.title: Juniper Labware newsletter: Freight pricing this quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest issue, "Freight pricing this quarter," links to a blog article and offers subscribers a companion piece with full charts.
- Article (blog.juniper.example/2026/freight): Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (insights.juniper.example): Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
